title: PPG-MS11 — Online Tuning Loop (live telemetry → outcome capture → post recalibration)
description: Closes the loop: live spindle load + feed override + dimensional outcome from MTConnect/OPC-UA flows back into PSAU-PPG-SFC outcome store, which recalibrates kc1.1 / Taylor C/n / chatter SLD per-machine, which gets baked into the next sidecar. Without this milestone the AGI gates from PPG-MS9 have only quote-time data; with it they have run-time data.
rationale: The post is a one-shot artifact today. The shop accumulates measured spindle load, actual cycle time, surface finish results, and tool change events — and none of it goes back to PRISM. This milestone makes the post a continuously-improving artifact whose sidecar gets sharper on every successful cut.
leverage_existing: MTConnect adapter (read-only) and OPC-UA adapter (write+read) — machine_live dispatcher (already wired)
PSAU-PPG-SFC outcome capture (already shipped) — provenance + outcome store
BayesianToolLifeEngine + ChatterStabilityLobeEngine — accept per-machine recalibration deltas
RTMI (Real-Time Manufacturing Intelligence) actions: rtmi_spindle_monitor, rtmi_chatter_detect, rtmi_tool_life_countdown

the_worked_example_that_proves_it.scenario: Hurco V11 cuts 50 D2 (ISO-H, kc1.1=3200) dies over 2 weeks. Each cut posts spindle load + cycle time to MTConnect.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.today_pre_ppg_ms11: Telemetry logged in MTConnect agent but never read back to PRISM. Sidecar kc1.1 stays at canonical 3200 (ISO-H) even though this Hurco actual measured kc1.1 trends to 3110 (slightly worn ballscrews → reduced effective rigidity).
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.should_be_post_ppg_ms11: Outcome aggregator notes a 60-cut sample; calibration delta calc trims kc1.1 to 3110 with σ=25 for this specific Hurco V11. Next post regeneration carries machine-specific override in the sidecar (canonical 3200 preserved in src/physics/constants.ts). Block-by-block S/F sharpens 3-5%.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.gap_now_closed: Posts get smarter the longer they run on a given machine.

units.title: Telemetry capture pipeline (MTConnect + OPC-UA reader)
units.scope: src/services/PostTelemetryIngestor.ts — periodic pull of spindle load, position, alarm, tool-change events; persist to outcome store with provenance

units.title: Outcome aggregator
units.scope: src/engines/PostOutcomeAggregatorEngine.ts — group by (machine, material, feature); compute mean + σ for kc1.1, Taylor C/n, chatter lobes, surface finish

units.title: Calibration delta computation
units.scope: src/engines/PostCalibrationDeltaEngine.ts — Bayesian update on canonical priors; emit per-machine override deltas with confidence

units.title: Feedback into post regeneration
units.scope: Sidecar emit (PPG-MS0 stage 0) consumes per-machine deltas; emits override block in sidecar JSON; block-by-block S/F (PPG-MS1) honors overrides

units.title: Closed-loop end-to-end test
units.scope: src/__tests__/OnlineTuningLoop.integration.test.ts — synthetic 50-cut telemetry stream → aggregator → delta → next post → assert measurable S/F sharpening, no chatter/force violation

units.title: post_outcome_record dispatcher action
units.scope: prism_cam dispatcher action post_outcome_record — write surface for outcome capture (per CLAUDE-CODEX-MCP-DIRECTIVE: every read needs a write).

units.title: Tool-life countdown emit (sister-tool swap M-codes + countdown comments)
units.scope: Wire rtmi_tool_life_countdown into PostProcessorPipelineEngine emit stage. Emit comment block with predicted tool-life remaining + sister-tool M-code (per controller dialect from MS5). Tier-aware: shop_floor emits sister-tool swap automatically when countdown <2× cycle time; sim emits warning only.

completion_criteria: Telemetry ingestor pulls from at least Hurco V11 (OPC-UA) and Okuma B250 (MTConnect) in continuous service mode
Aggregator + calibration delta produce per-machine overrides with confidence band
Next-generation post sidecar carries the overrides; block-by-block S/F honors them

Closed-loop test demonstrates ≥3% measurable cycle-time improvement at convergence (defined: rolling 10-cut Δ-feed-override <0.5% AND Δ-spindle-override <0.5% for ≥5 consecutive windows) with zero safety violations
